source.name: Nomi first-party procedural director mannequin
evidence: geometry, rig, skin weights, and walk/run keyframes are defined programmatically in scripts/generate-nomi-mannequin.py
the generator imports no external model or animation file
mixamorig bone names are retained only as a saved-project compatibility API

license.name: AGPL-3.0-only
license.note: First-party generated artifacts are redistributed under the repository license. Repository switched Apache-2.0 → AGPL-3.0-only on 2026-08-01 (docs/audit/2026-08-01-upstream-45-compatibility-license-audit.md); this record was updated 2026-08-02 to reconcile the prior stale Apache-2.0 label (Gate 7 P1 fix).

source.name: UE Mannequin (Retopology) by William Luque
evidence: the downloaded model includes a Sketchfab Standard license notice beside the GLB
the asset is used only by the opt-in Scene3D UE mannequin evaluation path
redistribution clearance for shipping the original GLB has not been independently confirmed

license.name: Sketchfab Standard License
license.note: Local evaluation is allowed by the supplied notice. Release redistribution remains blocked until the original model terms are reviewed and documented.

source.name: Seedance2 Chrome Extensions
evidence: Nomi discovers the extension through NOMI_SEEDANCE_EXTENSION_DIR or external local paths and does not package the extension directory

license.name: No license declared
license.note: The public upstream repository has no LICENSE or package license field. Nomi may integrate with a user-supplied local copy but must not copy or redistribute the extension.

source.name: Kenney Furniture Kit
evidence: the official asset page declares Creative Commons CC0
the official support page permits commercial use and does not require attribution
Nomi downloads only the pinned official HTTPS archive, verifies SHA-256, and extracts an allowlisted GLB entry
the archive is cached in user data and is never bundled in Nomi release artifacts

license.name: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal
license.note: Downloaded on demand from the official Kenney asset page. Nomi records source, pack, archive hash, file hash, and license with each imported Director asset.
